form.label: Root Cause Analysis
form.description: When the service is down, which layer is to blame? Top-down checks — client, hypervisor, both containers, their ports, app/DB health — plus corroborating SNMP traps.

search.query: | makeresults | appendcols [ search index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(_time) as lt | eval client=if(c>0 AND (now()-lt)<900,1,0) | fields client ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c, count(eval(status="error" OR status="not_configured")) as e | eval hv=if(c>e,1,0) | fields hv ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=webapp-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval webct=if(c>0,1,0) | fields webct ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=db-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval dbct=if(c>0,1,0) | fields dbct ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=port:probe port=8080 earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(open) as o | eval p8080=if(o=1,1,0) | fields p8080 ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=port:probe port=5432 earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(open) as o | eval p5432=if(o=1,1,0) | fields p5432 ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(reachable) as r | eval app=if(r=1,1,0) | fields app ] | eval client=coalesce(client,0), hv=coalesce(hv,0), webct=coalesce(webct,0), dbct=coalesce(dbct,0), p8080=coalesce(p8080,0), p5432=coalesce(p5432,0), app=coalesce(app,0) | eval RootCause=case( hv=0,"Hypervisor (Proxmox) unreachable", webct=0,"Web container (webapp-berlin) stopped", dbct=0,"DB container (db-berlin) stopped", p5432=0,"DB port 5432 closed", p8080=0,"Web port 8080 closed", app=0,"App/DB unhealthy (/healthz not 200)", client=0,"Client offline", true(),"All healthy — no root cause") | eval range=if(RootCause="All healthy — no root cause","low","severe") | table RootCause range

| makeresults | appendcols [ search index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(_time) as lt | eval v=if(c>0 AND (now()-lt)<900,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "1 Client" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c, count(eval(status="error" OR status="not_configured")) as e | eval v=if(c>e,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "2 Hypervisor" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=webapp-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval v=if(c>0,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "3 Web container" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=db-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval v=if(c>0,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "4 DB container" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=port:probe port=8080 earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(open) as o | eval v=if(o=1,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "5 Web :8080" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=port:probe port=5432 earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(open) as o | eval v=if(o=1,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "6 DB :5432" ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(reachable) as r | eval v=if(r=1,"OK","FAIL") | fields v | rename v as "7 App /healthz" ] | fields - _time | table "1 Client" "2 Hypervisor" "3 Web container" "4 DB container" "5 Web :8080" "6 DB :5432" "7 App /healthz"

index=berlin_web sourcetype=port:probe | stats latest(open) as open latest(_time) as last by service target | eval State=if(open=1,"open","closed"), "Last checked"=strftime(last,"%F %T") | rename service as Service, target as Target | table Service Target State "Last checked" | sort Service
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | timechart span=1m latest(reachable) as reachable avg(latency_ms) as "latency (ms)"

index=berlin_web sourcetype=linux:ps host=webapp-berlin event=process | stats latest(pcpu) as "CPU %", latest(pmem) as "Mem %", latest(_time) as t by comm pid | where t >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | sort - "CPU %" | head 8 | table comm pid "CPU %" "Mem %"

index=berlin_db sourcetype=linux:ps host=db-berlin event=process | stats latest(pcpu) as "CPU %", latest(pmem) as "Mem %", latest(_time) as t by comm pid | where t >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | sort - "CPU %" | head 8 | table comm pid "CPU %" "Mem %"

html.p: Read the chain top-down: the first FAIL is the root cause the verdict names. A stopped container, a closed port, or a failed /healthz each points at a different culprit — and an SNMP trap (e.g. a link/host-down notification) often explains why in real time. Only gary sees the whole chain.
